description: This PHP class 'TimesheetRow' models a row in a timesheet management system within the OrangeHRM project. It encapsulates the project, activity, dates, and associated timesheet items, providing methods to assign items and compute totals.

classes.name: TimesheetRow
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a row in a timesheet, including project details, activity, involved dates, total hours, and methods for assignment and retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetRow with a project, activity, and associated dates.

methods.name: setDates
methods.description: Prepares the internal dates array formatted as Ymd strings.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total hours/count assigned to this timesheet row.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total hours/count by a specified amount.

methods.name: assignTimesheetItem
methods.description: Associates a TimesheetItem with the specific date in this row, throwing an exception if one already exists for that date.

methods.name: getTimesheetItems
methods.description: Retrieves all TimesheetItems assigned to this row.
